claims: Easter Sunday is on April 5, 2026.
Easter is the central Christian holiday.
Easter commemorates the resurrection of Jesus Christ three days after his crucifixion.
Easter involves church services like vigils.
Easter involves fasting.
Easter involves decorating eggs.
Easter involves the Easter bunny.
Holy Week is the week preceding Easter.
Holy Week includes Palm Sunday.
Holy Week includes Maundy Thursday.
Maundy Thursday is the Last Supper.
Holy Week includes Good Friday.
Good Friday is the Crucifixion.
Easter Vigil is a service on Saturday night.
Easter Vigil transitions into Sunday morning.
Easter Vigil marks the resurrection with light and water.
Sunrise services are early morning church services held outdoors.
Sunrise services celebrate the empty tomb.
Easter eggs traditionally symbolize the empty tomb or new life.
Easter bunny and hunts are popular traditions involving egg hunts and candy.
Easter bunny and hunts are largely rooted in spring fertility symbols.
Easter traditions include sharing special meals with family such as lamb or ham.
Easter is a movable feast.
Easter is held on the first Sunday after the first full moon following the spring equinox.
Easter falls between March 22 and April 25.
